note: Crafting-grid recipes whose output trades on the bazaar. Alternatives are all kept; the price layer picks the cheapest. `offBazaar` names ingredients the bazaar does not sell, which need a shop price before that recipe can be costed. Forge and fusion are not carried.
intermediatesNote: Recipes making something the bazaar does not sell, kept because the recipes above are made of them. Paper is the plain case: three Sugar Cane make three Paper, Sugar Cane is a bazaar good, and Hot Potato Books are made of Paper — but Paper itself cannot be sold there, so it is not a craft, only a step. Its wiki page has no shop section at all, which is why an NPC price table does not reach these either. Closed transitively.
